entry.title: New: Bill 8 (2024) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, OFFICE OF THE MAYOR, ADMINISTRATION PROGRAM" The purpose of this bill is to amend the Fiscal Year 2024 Budget, Office of the Mayor, Administration Program by deleting the conditional language for watershed management planning and implementation under Environmental Protection, deleting the line item for Hoʻahu Energy Co-op Molokai and adding a new appropriation for the Maui Family Young Men's Christian Association in the amount of $200,000.
